disposition_reason: Table 3 prints mean ± SD minerals and Cd, Pb (with As and Hg not detected) in two Chinese and two Japanese commercial whole milks sampled eight times over a year and in raw Inner Mongolia milk.

study.design: Repeated retail sampling of four commercial whole milks plus one raw milk sample set
study.origin: Commercial milks made from 100% raw milk (China and Japan; Japan 2 from Jersey cows); raw milk from nomad herds, Inner Mongolia Prairie
study.market: local supermarkets in Suzhou, China and Yamanashi prefecture, Japan
study.period_text: commercial milks every 1.5 months, October 2006 to October 2007; raw milk May 2007
study.method: Microwave HNO3/H2O2 digestion of about 10 g milk; ICP-OES (macroelements), flame AAS (Fe, Mn, Zn), graphite furnace AAS (Cd, Cr, Cu, Mo, Pb), AFS (As, Hg, Se)
study.lod_text: As 0.06 µg/kg, Hg 0.015 µg/kg; others not stated
study.qa: Milk powder GBW10017 analysed in triplicate: Pb 0.07 vs certified 0.07 mg/kg, As 26 vs 31 µg/kg; no certified Cd value and only a recommended Hg value
